name: 비밀 서가 미로
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, maze-like library chamber formed by tall narrow bookshelf corridors branching in several directions, a weathered wooden ladder leaning against one shelf reaching toward an upper landing, dust drifting between the stacks, warm amber shelf-lanterns glowing against cool teal moonlight filtering from above, gentle elevated view through a broad architectural opening, open lower-central foreground, deep receding perspective, polished fantasy concept art.
